in_english.name: Vilhelmina
in_english.long_meaning: The name Vilhelmina is derived from the Old Norse elements 'wil' meaning 'will' or 'helmet' and 'heima' meaning 'God'. It can be interpreted as 'Will of God' or 'Helmeted protector of God'. In English, it is often translated as 'Helen of the World' or 'Helen of God'.
